note: Accessibility navigation shortcuts -- renders: Skip to main content, Skip to about this item, Skip to buying options, Skip to reviews, Search, Cart, Home, Your orders, Show shortcuts

Main navigation bar -- renders: Amazon logo, Deliver to, Search, Account, Orders, Cart, and fixed category links (e.g. Today's Deals, Customer Service); excludes user-specific location, account name, and cart count
Secondary navigation bar -- renders: fixed category links like Today's Deals, Customer Service, Registry, Gift Cards, Sell
Product image gallery controls -- renders: image thumbnails, video controls, and share buttons; image content is visual, not text instructions
Buy box controls -- renders: Add to Cart, Add to List, and availability status buttons
Customer reviews section chrome -- renders: rating histogram, filter tabs, and section headings; excludes individual user reviews and media
Site footer -- renders: Back to top, fixed navigation links (Conditions of Use, Privacy Notice, etc.), and language/currency selectors
